question: Is the 'adaptive repair loop' conceptually distinct from existing self-training / self-refine / iterative bootstrapping data-cleaning methods, and does it add value over simple one-pass denoising?
description: If the repair loop reduces to generic iterative self-training, its novelty should be dropped or narrowed to the KG-specific one-hop failure detector.
rationale: Self-Refine (arxiv:2303.17651) and bootstrapping structured knowledge tracing (KnowTrace, arxiv:2505.20245) already perform iterative self-generated refinement, so the distinctiveness of the repair loop needs evidence-based justification.
